comment: WHO Coding Tool and Embedded Coding Tool example — Appendix D supplies named SNOMED-oriented and generic servers, but omits WHO's own relevant services. This is a straightforward, verifiable correction. These tools are not claimed to be a complete national governance platform or an LIMR. API documentation (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/APIDoc-Version2/), local deployment (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/ICDAPI-LocalDeployment/), FHIR interface status (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/ICDAPI-FHIR-Support/), Embedded Coding Tool (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/icd11ect-1.8/EmbeddedCodingTool/).
